Title: Actual Cost Calculator + Currency Conversion
Summary: Deterministic estimated/actual cost calculation consuming the DB-M15 pricing catalogue only (no embedded rates), plus effective-dated USD->INR exchange-rate evidence. CostCalculationInput/Result v1, ExchangeRateRecord v1, CostVariance v1. Cached/uncached split without double billing, cache-write 5m/1h, config-driven reasoning billing (INCLUDED_IN_OUTPUT default), tool/media/storage other-cost with PARTIAL on missing rates. Historic pricing + FX reproducible; later rate/price changes never rewrite historic costs. Zero paid/FX/network calls, zero credentials.

Tests.Note: Token-cost matrix (14 scenarios), effective dating, 6 time-band boundaries reusing DB-M15 resolver, cached split 1M/400K no double billing, USAGE_INCOMPLETE, FX decimal/reproducibility/missing/non-mutation, variance, PARTIAL, schema v1, no-network scan.

SeedExchangeRates.Note: DEV fixtures (Source CONFIGURED, Notes 'DEV FIXTURE - not a live market rate.'): fx-usdinr-dev-v1 Rate 75.0 [2026-01-01, 2026-06-01), fx-usdinr-dev-v2 Rate 83.5 [2026-06-01, open). Historic evidence windows, never rewritten.
